'''Imperial Broadcast and Communications''' was a military agency affiliated with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They assisted the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] in their search for the kidnapped artist [[Crying Dawn Singer]].
